arxiv-2101-05503.title: Superconducting dome with e ​ x ​ t ​ e ​ n ​ d ​ e ​ d extended s s - w ​ a ​ v ​ e wave pairing symmetry in the heavily hole-overdoped copper-oxide planes
arxiv-2101-05503.creator: M. Zegrodnik, P. Wójcik, J. Spałek
arxiv-2101-05503.description: Abstract We analyze the two-orbital (with d x 2 − y 2 d_{x^{2}-y^{2}} and d 3 ​ z 2 − r 2 d_{3z^{2}-r^{2}} orbitals) analogue of the t t - J J - U U model as applied to the description of the copper-oxide monolayer deposited on the Bi 2 Sr 2 CaCu 2 O 8+δ substrate (CuO 2 /BSCCO).

arxiv-2207-03500.title: A Step in Understanding the S 8 S_{8} Tension
arxiv-2207-03500.creator: Melissa Joseph, Daniel Aloni, Martin Schmaltz, Eashwar N. Sivarajan, Neal Weiner
arxiv-2207-03500.description: Abstract Models of dark sectors with a mass threshold can have important cosmological signatures. If, in the era prior to recombination, a relativistic species becomes nonrelativistic and is then depopulated in equilibrium, there can be measurable impacts on the cosmic microwave background as the entropy is transferred to lighter relativistic particles.

arxiv-2310-16882.title: Light Dilaton in Rare Meson Decays and Extraction of its CP Property
arxiv-2310-16882.creator: Sudhakantha Girmohanta 1,2 , Yuichiro Nakai 1,2 , Yoshihiro Shigekami 1,2 and Kohsaku Tobioka 3,4 1 Tsung-Dao Lee Institute, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, 520 Shengrong Road, Shanghai 201210, China 2 School of Physics and Astronomy, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, 800 Dongchuan Road, Shanghai 200240
arxiv-2310-16882.description: Abstract The dilaton ϕ \phi is a pseudo-Nambu-Goldstone boson associated with the spontaneous breaking of scale invariance in a nearly conformal theory, and couples to the trace of the stress-energy tensor. We analyze experimental constraints on a light dilaton with mass in the MeV-GeV range from rare meson decays.

arxiv-2312-14330.title: Random anti-commuting Hermitian matrices
arxiv-2312-14330.creator: John E. M c Carthy, Hazel T. M c Carthy
arxiv-2312-14330.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by John E. M c Carthy, Hazel T. M c Carthy. We consider pairs of anti-commuting 2 ​ p 2p -by- 2 ​ p 2p Hermitian matrices that are chosen randomly with respect to a Gaussian measure. Generically such a pair decomposes into the direct sum of 2 2 -by- 2 2 blocks on which the first matrix has eigenvalues ± x j \pm x_{j} and the second has eigenvalues ± y j \pm y_{j} .

arxiv-2409-01285.title: Optimal L ⁡ ( d , 1 ) L(d,1) -labeling of certain direct graph bundles cycles over cycles and Cartesian graph bundles cycles over cycles
arxiv-2409-01285.creator: Irena Hrastnik Ladinek
arxiv-2409-01285.description: Abstract An L ⁡ ( d , 1 ) L(d,1) -labeling of a graph G G is an assignment of nonnegative integers to the vertices such that adjacent vertices receive labels that differ by at least d d and those at a distance of two receive labels that differ by at least one, where d ≥ 1 d\geq 1 .

arxiv-2504-07287.title: Hybrid Privilege Escalation and Remote Code Execution Exploit Chains
arxiv-2504-07287.creator: Miguel Tulla, Andrea Vignali, Cristian Colon, Anahita Srinivasan, Giancarlo Sperlì, Simon Pietro Romano, Masataro Asai, Erik Hemberg, Una-May O’Reilly
arxiv-2504-07287.description: Abstract Research on exploit chains has predominantly focused on sequences involving only one type of exploit, for example, either escalating privileges on a single machine or executing remote code on a network. Notwithstanding, in modern networks, hybrid exploit chains are critical because of their linkable vulnerabilities.

arxiv-2505-00724.title: Optimal Blackjack Betting Strategies Through Dynamic Programming and Expected Utility Theory
arxiv-2505-00724.creator: Lucas Bordeu, Javier Castro
arxiv-2505-00724.description: Abstract This study presents a rigorous mathematical approach to the optimization of round and betting policies in Blackjack, using Markov Decision Processes (MDP) and Expected Utility Theory. The analysis considers a direct confrontation between a player and the dealer, simplifying the dynamics of the game.

arxiv-2505-22885.title: Extensions of homogeneous distributions on deformations to the normal cone
arxiv-2505-22885.creator: Moudrik CHAMOUX
arxiv-2505-22885.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Moudrik CHAMOUX. Abstract On a deformation to the normal cone \operatorname{DNC}(M,V) we show that given a distribution u\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\operatorname{DNC}(M,V)\setminus V\times\mathbb{R}) if u is homogeneous of order a for the zoom action, then it admits an a -homogeneous extension \widetilde{u}\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\operatorname{DNC}(M,V)) . We describe all such extensions and discuss briefly about how it translates to the work of Van Erp and Yuncken in [ EY17 ] .

arxiv-2506-17716.title: Topological groups from matrices of sets
arxiv-2506-17716.creator: Boriša Kuzeljević, Stepan Milošević, Stevo Todorčević
arxiv-2506-17716.description: Abstract . We give a general construction of topological groups from combinatorial structures such as trees, towers, gaps, and subadditive functions. We connect topological properties of corresponding groups with combinatorial properties of these objects. For example, the group built from an ω 1 \omega_{1} -tree is Frechét iff the tree is Aronszajn.

arxiv-2507-22344.title: Risk-inclusive Contextual Bandits for Early Phase Clinical Trials
arxiv-2507-22344.creator: Rohit Kanrar, Chunlin Li, Zara Ghodsi, Margaret Gamalo
arxiv-2507-22344.description: Abstract Early-phase clinical trials face the challenge of selecting optimal drug doses that balance safety and efficacy due to uncertain dose-response relationships and varied participant characteristics. Traditional randomized dose allocation often exposes participants to sub-optimal doses by not considering individual covariates, necessitating larger sample sizes and prolonging drug development.

arxiv-2509-09158.title: IoTFuzzSentry: A Protocol Guided Mutation Based Fuzzer for Automatic Vulnerability Testing in Commercial IoT Devices
arxiv-2509-09158.creator: Priyanka Rushikesh Chaudhary and Rajib Ranjan Maiti
arxiv-2509-09158.description: Abstract Protocol fuzzing is a scalable and cost-effective technique for identifying security vulnerabilities in deployed Internet of Things (IoT) devices. During their operational phase, IoT devices often run lightweight servers to handle user interactions, such as video streaming or image capture in smart cameras.

doe-osti-3383409-impacts-of-dual-use-sol.title: Impacts of Dual-Use Solar (Agrivoltaics) on Crop Productivity and the Agricultural Economy in Massachusetts and Beyond
doe-osti-3383409-impacts-of-dual-use-sol.creator: Breger, Dwayne, Glaze-Corcoran, Samantha, Clay, Clem et al.
doe-osti-3383409-impacts-of-dual-use-sol.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. This project contributes applied research to better understand the impacts of agrivoltaics on farm microclimates, crop productivity, and economics at the farm and sector level. The site trial research is divided into two sets of site trials integrated into commercial farm and agr

pmc-10603068.title: Development of an accelerated cellular model for early changes in Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-10603068.creator: Huijing Xue, Sylvester Gate, Emma Gentry, Wolfgang Losert, Kan Cao
pmc-10603068.description: Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) is a leading cause of dementia characterized by amyloid plaques and neurofibrillary tangles, and its pathogenesis remains unclear. Current cellular models for AD often require several months to exhibit phenotypic features due to the lack of an aging environment in vitro. Lamin A is a key component of the nuclear lamina.

pmc-10647244.title: Biocompatibility Testing for Implants: A Novel Tool for Selection and Characterization
pmc-10647244.creator: Walid Al-Zyoud, Dana Haddadin, Sameer Ahmad Hasan, Hussamaldeen Jaradat, Olfa Kanoun, Peijiang Liu, Liguo Xu, Jintang Zhou
pmc-10647244.description: This review article dives into the complex world of biocompatibility testing: chemical, mechanical, and biological characterization, including many elements of biocompatibility, such as definitions, descriptive examples, and the practical settings. The focus extends to evaluating standard documents obtained from reliable organizations; with a particular focus on open-source information, including FDA-USA, ISO 10933 series, and TÜV SÜD.

pmc-10746477.title: Evaluating laser surface melting of NiCrAlY-APS coating and its effect on high-temperature oxidation behavior of NiCrAlY/YSZ thermal barrier coating before and after surface melting
pmc-10746477.creator: Mohammad Gavahian Jahromi, Reza Shoja Razavi, Zia Valefi, hamed Naderi, Saeid Taghi-Ramezani
pmc-10746477.description: This research study was conducted to investigate the laser melting parameters of NiCrAlY-APS coating. High-temperature oxidation was investigated using yttria partially stabilized zirconia (YSZ) ceramic coating. Also, the oxidation behavior of the TBC coating was investigated and studied before to and after laser surface melting of the NiCrAlY coating.

pmc-11371719.title: Genetically predicted the causal relationship between gut microbiota and the risk of polymyositis/dermatomyositis: a Mendelian randomization analysis
pmc-11371719.creator: Yanna Niu, Yaochen Zhang, Keyi Fan, Jialin Hou, Liu Liu, Heyi Zhang, Xinlei Geng, Xiyue Ma, Shilei Lin, Meilin Guo, Xiaofeng Li, Shengxiao Zhang
pmc-11371719.description: IntroductionObservational studies suggest associations between gut microbiota and polymyositis (PM) and dermatomyositis (DM), but causal relationships are unclear. We investigate the causal effects of gut microbiota on PM and DM, providing insights hoping to provide insights for future treatment and prevention.

pmc-11436799.title: Context-dependent agricultural intensification pathways to increase rice production in India
pmc-11436799.creator: Hari Sankar Nayak, Andrew J McDonald, Virender Kumar, Peter Craufurd, Shantanu Kumar Dubey, Amaresh Kumar Nayak, Chiter Mal Parihar, Panneerselvam Peramaiyan, Shishpal Poonia, Kindie Tesfaye, Ram K Malik, Anton Urfels, Udham Singh Gautam, João Vasco Silva
pmc-11436799.description: Yield gap analysis is used to characterize the untapped production potential of cropping systems. With emerging large-n agronomic datasets and data science methods, pathways for narrowing yield gaps can be identified that provide actionable insights into where and how cropping systems can be sustainably intensified.

pmc-11472535.title: Bilateral erector spinae plane block by multiple injection for pain control in pseudomyxoma peritonei surgery: a single-blind randomized controlled trial
pmc-11472535.creator: Shuang Yu, Guangya Gao, Ruiqing Ma, Liangyuan Lu, Yaoping Zhao, Zhanmin Yang
pmc-11472535.description: ObjectiveCurrently, the primary surgical treatment for pseudomyxoma peritonei (PMP) is cytoreductive surgery (CRS) combined with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC). The perioperative period is frequently accompanied by severe pain. Erector spinae plane block (ESPB) can enhance analgesia for abdominal surgery. The purpose of this study was to compare the analgesic effects of bilateral multiple-injection ESPB in patients with PMP.

pmc-11499895.title: Valsalva Maneuver Versus Carotid Sinus Massage for Supraventricular Tachycardia: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
pmc-11499895.creator: Abdullatif A Alfehaid, Osama T Almutairi, Mohammed H Albloushi, Ahmad A Alahmad, Malek K Hasan, Omar F Alawadhi, Abdullah A Alibrahim, Abdulrahman K Alfailakawi, Mshal Alhatm, Fahad N Almuhannadi, Abdullah W Alshuaib, Abdullah M Alharran
pmc-11499895.description: Supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) is one of the most common cardiac arrhythmias, characterized by a sudden increase in heart rate. Initial management often involves vagal maneuvers, including the Valsalva maneuver (VM) and carotid sinus massage (CSM). VM can be categorized into standard VM (sVM) and modified VM (mVM).

pmc-12327100.title: Self-Reported Late Effects in Childhood Cancer Survivors in Kenya
pmc-12327100.creator: Jesse Lemmen, Susan Mageto, Festus Njuguna, Nancy Midiwo, Sandra Langat, Terry Vik, Gertjan Kaspers, Saskia Mostert
pmc-12327100.description: BackgroundThe number of children surviving cancer in low and middle-income countries is expected to grow in the coming years. Knowledge about late effects and follow-up preferences in Kenya is lacking.ObjectivesThis study assessed self-reported late effects in Kenyan childhood cancer survivors and explored their preferences for survivorship care.

pmc-12526905.title: From Network Sensors to Intelligent Systems: A Decade-Long Review of Swarm Robotics Technologies
pmc-12526905.creator: Fouad Chaouki Refis, Nassim Ahmed Mahammedi, Chaker Abdelaziz Kerrache, Sahraoui Dhelim
pmc-12526905.description: Swarm Robotics (SR) is a relatively new field, inspired by the collective intelligence of social insects. It involves using local rules to control and coordinate large groups (swarms) of relatively simple physical robots. Important tasks that robot swarms can handle include demining, search, rescue, and cleaning up toxic spills.

pmc-13070070.title: Deep learning-based classification of nitrate and nitrite concentrations from water samples using colorimetric test strip images
pmc-13070070.creator: Muhammad Roman, Mazhar Sher, Chamika Kuruppuarachchi, Arshid Ali, Chulwoo Pack, Azlan Zahid, Ali Mirzakhani Nafchi
pmc-13070070.description: Accurate monitoring of nitrate and nitrite concentrations in water is essential for sustainable agriculture, safeguarding public health, and protecting aquatic ecosystems from nutrient pollution. Traditional methods for detecting nitrate and nitrite in water samples are precise but costly, complex, and time-consuming, limiting their practicality for frequent on-site testing.

pmc-13076586.title: Advances in antimicrobial peptides: promising cancer treatments and vaccines
pmc-13076586.creator: Gehane Ghaly, Hatem Tallima, Tamer Shoeib
pmc-13076586.description: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs), long recognized for their broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity, have recently gained prominence as versatile anticancer agents. This review synthesizes recent advances positioning anticancer peptides (ACPs) at the forefront of novel oncological strategies, driven by their unique biophysical properties.

pmc-13288141.title: Enhanced electronic coupling in tetraaryl molecular junctions with osmium(iv) centers
pmc-13288141.creator: Luana Zagami, Mukund Sharma, Andrew Fraire, Cynthia Avedian, Clarissa Olivar, Thomas M. Czyszczon-Burton, Jazmine Prana, Sandugash Yergeshbayeva, María Camarasa-Gómez, Daniel Hernangómez-Pérez, Michael S. Inkpen

pmc-13463265.title: Vasoactive Intestinal Peptide (VIP)-Secreting Neuroblastic Tumors in Children Presenting With Chronic Secretory Diarrhea: A Report of Two Cases
pmc-13463265.creator: Maha Barbar, Iyad Sultan, Abdulrahman Alrifaai, Ahmad Al-Dabbagh, Hadeel Halalsheh
pmc-13463265.description: Vasoactive intestinal peptide (VIP)-secreting neuroblastic tumors are rare pediatric neoplasms that may present with chronic secretory diarrhea prior to tumor detection, posing significant diagnostic and therapeutic challenges. VIP-induced diarrhea is typically profuse, watery, and refractory to standard management, often resulting in dehydration, electrolyte imbalance, weight loss, and failure to thrive.

pmc-13561035.title: From rule-taking to rule-making chemistry: a minimal population–environment feedback model
pmc-13561035.creator: Celia Blanco
pmc-13561035.description: A key step towards life is the shift from chemistry that merely adapts to its surroundings to chemistry that actively reshapes the local physicochemical conditions that rule its own replication. Using a coupled population–environment feedback model, we identify the conditions under which environment-modifying activity, once present, can become self-sustaining in mixed chemical populations.

pmc-13562746.title: Model-driven analysis reveals oxidative stress adaptation enabling efficient energy utilization in a Crabtree-negative Saccharomyces cerevisiae
pmc-13562746.creator: Albert Tafur Rangel, Andrés Castillo García, Carl Malina, Verena Siewers, Eduard J Kerkhoven
